description: Lounge and lounge-like benefit records for Accor properties, researched per city. One file per city at data/benefits/<city-slug>.json containing a JSON array of these records. Git history is the audit trail; last_verified marks staleness per record.
note_on_join_key: accor_hotel_code is the only reliable join to the extension runtime. Hotel names differ between Accor's lounge page, the catalog API and third-party sites (e.g. 'Novotel Phnom Penh BKK1' vs 'BKK 1'). Never join on name.

fields.hotel_name: string — display name as shown on all.accor.com
fields.brand: string — Sofitel, Novotel, TRIBE, ibis budget, Raffles, ...
fields.accor_hotel_code: string — Accor hotel ID, the join key to the extension

values.verified: Key claims confirmed against a first-party source (hotel or Accor page)
values.partially_verified: Some claims first-party, others rest on third-party reports
values.verified_absent: Confirmed the property has no lounge and no club room tier
values.unverified: Not yet checked against any source

on_official_lounge_list.note: Resolve from the newest data/lounge/YYYY-MM.json rather than guessing. Only use "unverified" if no extraction is available.

fields.sells_club_room_category: boolean — strong proxy for a physical lounge existing
fields.lounge_name: string | null — include floor/location if known, e.g. "Club Millesime (ground floor as of Feb 2026)"

benefit_type.note: discounted_happy_hour is NOT a free perk — the UI must not badge it as one.

values.room_category_only: Hotel states club-room/suite guests only, no loyalty route
values.room_category_or_platinum: Room category published; Platinum access reported but not hotel-published
values.platinum_only: Status-based access, no room category involved
values.platinum_discretionary: Granted case by case, e.g. at check-in discretion
values.unknown: No evidence either way — use this rather than guessing

fields.hours: object | "unknown" — free-form keys such as lounge_open, afternoon_tea, evening_cocktails, happy_hour, rooftop_bar. State the source inline when windows conflict.
fields.alcohol_detail: string — what is served and whether it is included or paid
fields.complimentary: boolean | "unknown" — false means the benefit exists but costs money

values.verified_primary: Confirmed on a hotel-owned or Accor-owned page
values.multiple_reports: Two or more independent third-party reports agree
values.single_report: One review or forum post only — treat as weak

fields.evidence_source: string[] — URLs, plus repo paths like 'data/lounge/2026-08.json' for official-list facts
fields.notes: string — free text. Record what could NOT be verified, not just what could.

research_rules: Say "unknown" rather than "none" where no evidence was found either way. Absence of a review mentioning a perk is not evidence the perk is absent.
Resolve on_official_lounge_list from the newest data/lounge extraction — it is authoritative and free.
Do not attribute wording to a source without reading that source. If a claim rests on a search summary rather than the page itself, say so in notes.
Mark discounted or paid offers with complimentary:false — never let a paid happy hour read as a status perk.
Prefer first-party hours over aggregator hours when they conflict, and say which was chosen.
Note relocations and rebrands (e.g. a lounge moving floors) so stale reviews can be discounted.
